compute_embedding_quality_metrics: compute Qlocal and Qglobal quality scores for a dimensionality reduction embedding using euclidean or poincare distance
compute_geodesic_distances: compute geodesic distances on a KNN graph manifold for a high-dimensional dataset
compute_ranking_matrix: compute a pairwise ranking matrix from a distance matrix using sorted neighbor indices
compute_coranking_matrix: compute the co-ranking matrix Q from high-dimensional and low-dimensional ranking matrices
compute_qnx_scalar_scores: compute Qlocal, Qglobal, and Kmax scalar scores from a Qnx curve array
